content: Ersani Yanzii Suruku
Olien matai wiqiku mutun matande imegheni ganzhen beisan kun wine. Ingiese yanyanji achan, matai chigharade jiohoro giesan zuini xieidene rennai giezhi matai melie beilasan holukui bisai gieye.

Mai xianxin giekuni kaishi gieghazhi onchen gieghasan Ersani goude uzheye. Hhei melie beilasan bayasukude oluzhi hhe shizijiani kui shouizhi shizheghakui meilade uzhedene Hudai baozoi borun miende souzho.
Ta zuirenla fandui giesei rennai giesan Ersai ta goude sumula. Ingiese ta ulie hhechezhi zhughe ulie widane.
Ta zuighala eghinduzhoma, chusun usuruku chendude ese kuruzho.
Kewosiladene surughazhi kieliesan mutun Huda tande surughazhi kieliesan kielienyi ta matawu? Kieliezho,

content.text: "Mii kewon, Ezhan gonjizhi surughasei chi meilade bu uzhe.

content: Tai gonjizhi surughakude rennai gie. Huda tai kewonne mutun uzhezho. Alinie kewonde ada gonjizhi ulie surughane?
Kewon danlasanla man gonjizhi surughasei jienliezho. Tande gonjizhi surughasan uwoshi kewon pusho, zagieda wo.
Pse matanyi gonjizhi surughasan beyeni adai matan zunjizho. Matan ruhherni Adai genjia shunjizhi ulie amituranu?
Beyeni ada zhanshi jiere goyane isighala mai gonjizhi surughazho. Zinie ruhherni Ada mai gonjizhi surughakushi matande haochu ireghazhi hhei zhiguinide guzi beighane giezho.
Jien gonjizhi surughasanlashi danshi ese bayasudene nango giezhoma, khuinashi lienjizhi daosan kunlade pinnantu jiego irene, gundande udu daone.
Ingiese ta lilian witu kha, zholieresan shigharane zhidagha.
Kondene oluzhi moni giezhi zhidagha, ingiese dogholosan shighara ulie banjizhi goudane.
Nenjien Ogisan Hudai Bu Benda
Ta soyuji kunlare heqishizhi zhiguide udu daokui xiacha gie. Zhigui uwoshi kiema Ezhanni chanla dane.
Ta xioxin gie, pse niezhan kunla Hudai nenjiense likai giene, pse du winetu genzi khizhedene tai jiohoro giezhi olon kunlai zannanshighane.
Lon kijiezhi Isao mutun xienlian wizhi gouji idun ijiunide oluzhi fugie kewonni qienlii huine.
Ta mejiene. Hhe khuinashi adani onxian giesei jienliene giese adani dain ese giezho. Wilazhi xiahua gieliuzhe adane zhughei khareighaku banfa widazho.
Ta maqi shidaku, khan sidera, olien khi, kharani, honfen kei,
laba shenqi, kielien kieliesan shenqitu ulade ese irezho. Hhe shenqii sonosusan kunla pse kielien bu kielie giezhi Hudade xiahua giezho.
Ene ulani shighasanlai yewoiliuzhe tashida ala giesan minlinni hhela danji dazho.
Chanlasan zhenzhenji ayighase Musaliuzhe, "Bi hende ayizhi pugharazho." giezhi kieliezho.
Ingiezhoma, ta Xiwunshan, chanqiku Hudai chenshide irezho. Hheshijiu asiman jieredu Yelusalen wo, shuzi witu qienxienla bayasuzhi hhantulasan hhende wo.
Ta asiman jiere nierei jilasan fugie kewonlai jiohui, soyujilai panjichen Hudai hhende irezho. Hulunshighasan gou kunni ruhherlai hhende wo.
Ta shini yenjisei dundadu kun Ersai hhende, xireighasan chusunyi hhende irezho. Ene chusun kieliesan Hhabini chusun kieliesanse genjia gou wo.

Ta xioxin giezhi tande kielien kieliesan hhei fandui bu gie. Eqighandei Isilie kunla zemin jiere goyalai jingao giesei fandui giedene zuise anda dazho, asiman jierese matanyi jingao giesei fandui giese matan zuise matugie andane?
Hhe xienzide hhei shenqi zeminyi gojiolughazho. Ede hhe dain giezhi kieliezho, "Bi pse niefa zeminyi gojiolughazhi asimanyiye gojiolughane."
Pse niefa giesan ene kielienni isishi gojiolughasanlai, yejiushi zhayaghasanlai noighazhi ulie gojiolusanlai feilieghane giezho.
Ingiese matan ulie gojioluku gojiani jienliese mafan gieye. Xienlian, zunjiku zhugheghala Hudai bayasughazhi beiiye.
Matai Hudashi sidera widaghaku khan wo.
